byline_current_documents/view:
WITH sq AS (
         SELECT byline_document_versions.id,
            byline_document_versions.document_id,
            byline_document_versions.collection_id,
            byline_document_versions.collection_version,
            byline_document_versions.event_type,
            byline_document_versions.status,
            byline_document_versions.is_deleted,
            byline_document_versions.created_at,
            byline_document_versions.updated_at,
            byline_document_versions.created_by,
            byline_document_versions.change_summary,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY byline_document_versions.document_id ORDER BY byline_document_versions.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.byline_document_versions
          WHERE (byline_document_versions.is_deleted = false)
        )
 SELECT sq.id,
    sq.document_id,
    sq.collection_id,
    sq.collection_version,
    sq.event_type,
    sq.status,
    sq.is_deleted,
    sq.created_at,
    sq.updated_at,
    sq.created_by,
    sq.change_summary,
    byline_documents.order_key,
    byline_documents.source_locale
   FROM (sq
     JOIN public.byline_documents ON ((byline_documents.id = sq.document_id)))
  WHERE (sq.rn = 1);
byline_current_published_documents/view:
WITH sq AS (
         SELECT byline_document_versions.id,
